usage.callShape: POST https://pay.clawmoney.ai/hub/escrow/:id with JSON body (escrow payment details); :id = a pre-existing escrow record ID
quirks: URL has unresolved path template :id (an escrow record ID) with no source in schema/instructions/managedResource — cannot be fabricated
Outward/irreversible: agent-to-agent escrow payment; needs a real recipient + a created escrow before calling
inputSchema is a bare http-GET stub (no field defs); paymentAccepts empty; price is 'Varies'
Probe shows 402 (looks payable) but that does not mean a fabricated :id will work — paying a bad id would 404 and lose USDC
usage.guide: This endpoint settles an agent-to-agent escrow payment and requires an existing escrow ID in the path (:id). Before calling, you must already have created/obtained that escrow resource and its id — the registry spec provides no way to mint one, so a fresh agent cannot call this blind. Resolve the :id from a prior escrow-creation step, then POST the payment body. Treat as outward/irreversible and get user approval (real funds move).
